critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1672 lines — modularization still pending from iterations 3/4.

put_checkout_settings replaces the full doc on $set (model_dump). Since the CheckoutSettings model carries defaults for every field, PUT with partial payload silently blanks out other fields. Admin UI always sends the full state so OK, but any external PUT with partial body (e.g. for brand only) would nuke tutorial_links/energy_rules. Consider PATCH or exclude_unset+dict-merge.

fetch_evm_transfers_rpc paginates eth_getLogs across potentially many blocks (one eth_getBlockByNumber per log just for timestamp). For BEP20 with a 3s block time and 24h window this is ~28,800 blocks; a log hit triggers a per-block fetch — if there are hundreds of transfers it becomes slow. Consider block-timestamp caching, or chunking eth_getLogs by block range and batching getBlockByNumber calls.

/chain/sync endpoint iterates addresses sequentially inside the request; with Cloudflare 60s edge timeout this is on the edge of safe. Should be a background job returning a job-id, with GET /chain/sync/{id} status.

Admin PUT checkout settings uses List[dict] without inner validation for tutorial_links / energy_rules — malformed entries (e.g. {'title': 123}) would pass. Introduce TutorialLink and EnergyRule BaseModels.

CheckoutPage: Linkify regex /(https?:\/\/[^\s，。）)]+)/g strips Chinese punctuation but will keep trailing punctuation like semicolons; minor UX. Also Linkify is used on tutorial-content whitespace-pre-wrap but the Chinese ellipsis '…' and full-stop handled OK.
CheckoutSettingsDialog.save sends tutorial_links filtered by t.title.trim() — empty-title items silently dropped on save, which is OK but a hint ('空标题将不保存') would improve UX.
